US built taller smokestacks to cut local pollution; acid rain spread farther
description: In an effort to mitigate local air pollution, American power companies constructed towering smokestacks, effectively releasing sulfur dioxide and nitrogen oxides into higher winds. Unfortunately, this practice contributed to acid rain, harming ecosystems throughout North America. In response, Congress revised the Clean Air Act to restrict the use of tall stacks and improve emission control by emphasizing source capture instead.

title: New Jersey built seawall to stop erosion; the beach it protected disappeared
description: In New Jersey, the construction of a seawall has safeguarded properties but has inadvertently resulted in the disappearance of the sandy shoreline. The energy from waves is redirected downwards, which has stripped away sand and left no beach visible even during low tide. This hard engineering tactic disrupts the natural flow of sand and hinders the migration of barrier islands.

title: Why iPhones are so expensive in India again
description: New iPhone prices have significantly increased in India due to component costs and import duties.  Apple's foldable iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro now carry substantial price tags.  This rise contrasts with India's past affordability for iPhones after local assembly began.  Global memory chip shortages and AI demand are impacting smartphone manufacturing costs.  Financing options and aspirational buying continue to shape the Indian premium smartphone market.

title: Smuggled gold Rs 8,000 cheaper per 10g; 100 tonnes may enter India this year

title: Shruti Haasan’s Rs 15 crore Mumbai duplex blends gothic decor and bold interiors
description: In her Mumbai duplex, Shruti Haasan vividly expresses her unique character and artistic vision. The space blends industrial concrete with daring, eclectic decor, culminating in a music room that serves as the soulful center, filled with instruments. The striking juxtaposition of lively colors and gothic elements enhances her living areas, allowing the home to resonate as an intrinsic part of her essence rather than a simple dwelling.

title: Team India absence can't slow Mohammed Shami down: ‘Eyes always on next level’

He emphasises the importance of self-motivation at this level, striving to seize every chance to contribute to his team’s success. The pacer emphasises hard work as his foundation, trusting that fate will take care of the rest.

Furthermore, e-commerce companies will need to manage customer grievances effectively and work with the National Consumer Helpline, along with stricter regulations concerning data usage, imported items, and fee bundling.

The Coast Guard had launched a search for three missing boaters after the vessel failed to return. Two other boaters were found dead in the water and taken to Nome with the survivor.

title: Pennsylvania family’s 110-year-old farm is now township’s last working farm
description: Maple Acres Farm remains Plymouth Township's last working farm, a testament to agricultural heritage.  The McKeown family has preserved thirty acres of land since nineteen sixteen.  This farm now serves as a community market and pick-your-own destination.  It thrives by adapting its business model to suburban surroundings.  Community support and family dedication ensure its continued operation.

description: Federal agents arrested a former startup executive in Florida just as she was set to board a cruise ship. She is accused of swindling over $13 million from venture capital funds by falsely portraying herself as a licensed CPA while fabricating revenue reports. It is alleged that the funds were misappropriated for personal luxuries, including an extravagant wedding, leaving investors with substantial financial setbacks after her company's abrupt downfall.

Taylor Swift fan helps discover 12 insect species, names 4 after singer and albums
description: A new genus of Australian insects has been named Swiftiephylus after singer Taylor Swift.  Four new species within this genus also bear names inspired by her music.  These pale yellow and cream-colored insects were collected between 1995 and 2004.  Their discovery highlights the vast undocumented insect diversity remaining globally.  This naming brings attention to insect conservation and scientific discovery.

title: How BJP, Congress turned 80s AI trend turned into an all-out meme war
description: A new social media phenomenon has politicians reimagining their current images as vibrant 1980s portraits using AI technology. This trend has quickly morphed into a creative form of political satire, with the BJP and Congress leveraging it to exchange jabs. Leaders like Piyush Goyal and Kiren Rijiju are riding the retro wave, and even Rahul Gandhi has joined the fray with quirky AI-generated images.

title: Purple Cap at 40, world record at 47: Tahir becomes oldest 5-wicket taker in T20s
description: Imran Tahir made history by taking a phenomenal five-wicket haul in the Caribbean Premier League, earning the title of the oldest cricketer to achieve such a milestone in men's T20 cricket. This outstanding performance not only led the Guyana Amazon Warriors to victory but also demonstrates his unwavering passion for the game, fueled by encouragement from his son. This achievement further embellishes his rich T20 legacy.

title: Pakistan blinks on Houthis, walks back Saudi defence warning within 24 hours
description: Pakistan has clarified that there are no current discussions about military responses related to the Mecca defense pact, following recent warnings from its defense minister. The agreement aims to enhance deterrence and defense cooperation among the involved nations, becoming active only if the Yemen conflict spreads to Saudi Arabia. Additionally, Pakistan has confirmed that there are no immediate plans to expand the Mecca defense alliance.

title: Akash stares at BSP exit: Why Mayawati decided to 'free' nephew ahead of UP polls
description: Amid political turmoil, Akash Anand has again been demoted by Mayawati, who has questioned her nephew's maturity. His X profile has devolved from National Convenor to Party Worker and now to Supporter. His younger sibling, Ishan Anand, has been brought to the centre stage. Mayawati freed Akash political prospects to his father-in-law's exit from the scene, as the BSP confronts a challenging landscape with dwindling votes and approaching UP elections.

title: Sent home by PCB, Rizwan and Imam summoned by Pakistan's national cyber crime agency
description: In a surprising turn of events, Pakistani cricketers Mohammad Rizwan and Imam-ul-Haq have been summoned for questioning by the National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency. This inquiry comes shortly after their return from a disappointing series defeat. The agency plans to analyze data from their mobile phones, previously secured by the Pakistan Cricket Board.

title: Cristiano Ronaldo vs Travis Kelce net worth: The staggering $1.11 billion gap
description: Cristiano Ronaldo's impressive wealth of $1.2 billion dwarfs Travis Kelce's $90 million fortune. This staggering sum is primarily due to his rich contract with Al Nassr and a plethora of global business endeavors. Kelce, on the other hand, generates income from his NFL career, endorsements, and the success of his podcast 'New Heights'. With his recent relationship with Taylor Swift, his marketability has soared, leading to numerous new opportunities.

title: From voter ID to $5,000 cheques: Trump goes desi, mimics India’s election toolkit
Delhi building collapse: Can a 'no-responsibility' clause shield a PG owner?
description: A building collapse in Satya Niketan killed seven people and injured several others.  Rent agreements containing disclaimer clauses do not absolve PG owners of liability.  Legal experts state that such clauses cannot permit conduct violating legal duties.  Families of victims can still seek compensation if negligence and causation are proven.  Investigations will determine the ultimate responsibility of owners and authorities involved.

title: Failed farm cut 50 miles of ditches; scientists now plan to reflood peatland
description: In a significant ecological effort, North Carolina is working to restore its ancient peatlands that suffered damage from farming practices impacting their carbon storage capabilities. The previous drainage systems caused water levels to drop, resulting in peat exposure to air and increased emissions. Restoration efforts include blocking these ditches to enhance land rehydration and restore the water table.

title: Businessman murder: ‘Killer bahu’, hubby made 330 calls to ex-servant in 21 days
description: Police arrested a daughter-in-law and former domestic help for a businessman's murder.  Frequent calls between the daughter-in-law and the help preceded the fatal incident.  Investigators found evidence of a three-month planning period for the alleged murder.  The duo reportedly entered the victim's flat disguised as delivery personnel.  CCTV footage and call records aided police in reconstructing the conspiracy.

title: ‘Are you in relationship?’ How woman 'manipulated' ex-staffer to kill father-in-law
description: Investigators found WhatsApp messages indicating Shalu urged Vishal Gautam to murder her father-in-law. Shalu and Vishal engaged in conversations for months, with Shalu complimenting Vishal and inquiring about his relationship status. Police believe Shalu manipulated Vishal into planning and executing the murder of Vineet Minocha. Vishal erased chat history but failed to remove all WhatsApp call records, which investigators recovered.

title: 1980s AI Photo trend: 5 ChatGPT prompts to create Kerala-style retro images
description: A social media trend uses ChatGPT to recreate photos in 1980s styles. Users are now focusing on regional aesthetics, specifically 1980s Kerala and Malayali culture. Prompts request authentic family, wedding, college, and studio portraits from the period. These images incorporate traditional clothing, jewellery, and home settings from Kerala. The AI maintains recognizable facial features while adding retro photographic elements.

title: iPhone Duo, 18 Pro & Pro Max launched: Check India prices, availability, other details
description: Apple has launched its first foldable iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro models.  The iPhone Duo features a large inner display and a smaller outer screen.  iPhone 18 Pro models boast a new 48MP camera and extended battery life.  All devices run on the powerful A20 Pro chip and offer eSIM-only functionality.  Pre-orders and availability dates for India have been announced for these new iPhones.
